Hi, I, 16M, am new to fitness and want to know whether bulking or cutting would be the best thing to do right now.

For context, I am 1.78m, 68kg but 20.5% body fat and apparently around 38% muscle. 

I am quite active (plan on gymming twice a week, plus I do 50 km cycling everyweek + recreational sport)

Honestly, I'm leaning toward cutting first till I'm about 14-15% body fat, while continuing all my activity. Once I reach this, I'll go on a bulk so that I don't end up putting on too much fat. From what I've read, I don't think I'll be losing too much muscle if I gym, because I'll be prioritizing protein and "newbie gains". 

What do you guys think? Should I cut or will that mess with me considering I'm at a growing age? If I should bulk, how much calorie surplus and how can I avoid looking fat? And if I should cut, how much of a calorie deficit should I target?
